1) Medisoft to send the vendor security questionnaire (or HubSpot VSQ link) — target: EOD Tue 2027-04-06
2) If you can share the VSQ, our security team (Hannah) will triage and return answers + a redacted pen report within 3 business days after NDA is in place.
3) If you want the full pen-report, we require a CDA/NDA signed + request (we can share a sample NDA).
4) Tentative scanning cadence we recommend for customers in pre-production: monthly external scans, quarterly internal scans, and weekly vulnerability monitoring. We can adjust based on your risk posture.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Compliance & Pen-Test Next Steps (Medisoft Health)

Jordan — great to meet you by email. I’m Redwood’s security lead for new integrations; thanks for sharing the VSQ stub. A few clarifications and what we can commit to for the intake: 

What we will share
- Redacted pen-test report: includes executive summary, affected modules, CVSS scores, and remediation status at time of report. Full raw artifacts (screenshots, raw logs) require a CDA.
- Evidence for SOC 2 / controls: we can provide our public SOC 2 summary + control mappings. If you need Type II artifacts, we can discuss the appropriate NDA and timing.

Vulnerability management (TL;DR) — summary SLA table below: 
- Critical (RCE, active exploitation): initial ack < 4 hours; mitigation plan communicated within 24 hours.
- High (privilege escalation, data exfil): initial ack < 24 hours; targeted fix or compensating control within 3 business days.
- Medium: triage within 3 business days; patch/mitigation within 10 business days.
- Low: triage within 7 business days; remediation within 30 calendar days.

Scanning cadence we follow for hosted customers
- External vulnerability scans: weekly automated scans, monthly manual review by security ops.
- Internal / application security scans: quarterly (or on major releases).
- Pen tests: commissioned annually or before major production integrations. We also accept customer-initiated pen-tests; we request coordination and a scoped plan to avoid impact.

Coordinated disclosure and remediation windows
- Standard: 30-day coordinated remediation window for non-critical findings; exceptions handled case-by-case.
- For critical findings with active exploitation we will engage immediately and can apply emergency mitigation or fallbacks.

Attachments I’m sharing for your intake: redwood_vuln_process.pdf (overview + SLA table) and sample_pen_report_stub.pdf (redacted example). If you want the full report, please route your CDA and signed NDA to legal@medisofthealth.com and we’ll process per our sharing checklist.

Proposed follow-up
- If Medisoft can send back the VSQ by EOD Tue 2027-04-06, I’ll return a completed VSQ section by Fri 2027-04-09 and attach the redacted pen report.
- If you prefer a 30-minute sync with security, I have availability Wed 2027-04-07 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2027-04-08 13:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — I’ll watch for the VSQ and Jordan’s confirmation on the NDA path.

— Hannah Schmitt
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
